body: Founder: ensure we have controller mappings for all games. Same pattern as WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS: SDL_GameController, hot-plug, keyboard fallback, real pressure-sensitive fire off the right trigger's actual analog travel, dual-stick move/look, A/B/X/Y+triggers mapped to jump/crouch/reload/use/ability. gcc clean, not yet live-verified under Xvfb given time constraints this pass -- structurally identical to the already-proven pattern.
title: Real Xbox controller support
